summary: existing dev seed's pruneStaleSeedRecipes deletes ANY recipe id matching 'seed-%' that is not in its OWN keep-set, so a second seed file using the documented 'seed-<slug>' convention has its rows silently deleted whenever the first seed runs
evidence: services/web/src/db/seeds/1787000664088_dev_recipes.ts pruneStaleSeedRecipes(): selectFrom('recipe').where('id','like','seed-%') then deletes every id not in keep. keep is built only from that file's own corpus. kysely-ctl runs seeds in filename order and does not track applied state, so 'seed run' re-runs both every time; running the older file alone wipes the newer file's corpus.
